name: Ring of Warmth

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

summary: Resistance to Cold damage; you and what you wear are unharmed by temperatures down to -50 °F.
text: While wearing this ring, you have Resistance to Cold damage. In addition, you and everything you wear and carry are unharmed by temperatures as low as -50 degrees Fahrenheit.
